rationale: A fixed controller-time reserve is an immutable duration bound needed when sizing the one physical controller Job. Its name is concise and distinguishes controller overhead from per-wave reserve time.
alternatives: derive from planned_campaign_duration_seconds, but the needed provider safety margin is policy rather than derivable campaign data
merge with wave_reserve_seconds, but controller-level and per-wave reserve have different scopes
simplestChoice: Keep controller_reserve_seconds as an integer duration in the immutable controller policy.
